title: STS-80 film frame 1: small white elongated object near Earth's limb from Columbia window
description: Color film photograph (red frame-edge markings visible) taken through Space Shuttle Columbia's window during STS-80, November-December 1996. Earth's cloud-covered limb fills the left half; a small bright white elongated object floats near frame center against the dark of space, with window structure reflections at right. First of three frames of the unidentified object.
